title: Runner provider account inventory
description: Read-only proof through providerAccounts.snapshot and real Config/Fleet controls. Requires macOS, Pi Anthropic logins on FARMSLOT_ACCOUNT_MACHINES, the operator gateway in FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and its UI in FARMSLOT_UI_URL. Does not send model requests or copy credentials. Status-command checks overwrite the clipboard.

inventory.intent: Prove per-runner provider/account arrays on local and remote execution hosts, no fabricated Pi email/quota, explicit unavailable hosts, provider rows after real Config refresh and Fleet account-button clicks, and exact clipboard contents from each manual status-command button.
